### Fasting in Secret
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fasting-secret
Passage: Matthew 6:17-18
Points:
- Hypocrites in Jesus' day made a public show of fasting by looking disheveled to advertise their spirituality.
- Jesus did not eliminate fasting, but instructed disciples to hide their devotion so it remains private.
- Believers should wash and maintain a joyful, normal appearance so only God knows they are fasting.
- Seeking human admiration forfeits God's lasting blessing, whereas secret piety pleases the Father.
- Fasting deepens prayer and spiritual growth by reminding believers of their absolute dependence on God.

### The Heart of Christian Fasting, Part 2: Fasting in the Sermon on the Mount
Author: Grace to You
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B110111/the-heart-of-christian-fasting-part-2-fasting-in-the-sermon-on-the-mount
Passage: Matthew 6:16-18
Points:
- Fasting is intended to be an urgent, humble seeking of God, not a performance for human approval.
- Parading spiritual disciplines feeds personal pride and exchanges eternal reward for shallow applause.
- Disciples are commanded to appear and act entirely normal to deliberately conceal their fasting.
- Believers must reject manipulative, legalistic demands and focus their hearts exclusively on God.
- Concealing spiritual acts creates genuine intimacy with the heavenly Father who sees and rewards what is done in secret.
